system.description:
Your lightning reflexes allow you to complete complex actions in response to the actions of others.

Effect: Once per encounter, you can use two different Reactions in response to the same trigger. For example, if you use the Deflect Talent and fail to negate the attack, you can also use Negate Energy as a response to the same attack.

Normal: Without this Feat, you can use only one Reaction in response to a particular trigger.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
